urlText: Sydney CBD & North Sydney bus diversions for Sydney Marathon
content:

From 2am to 12pm, routes 202, 207 and 208 buses will run to and from Crows Nest only. Buses will not run to or from the city.

Stops on Miller St, Pacific Hwy, Bridge St and Blue St will be missed.  
 
Change for metro services to continue your trip between Crows Nest and the city.  
 
Please allow extra travel time and check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations. Visit the Sydney Marathon event page for more transport details.
